entities.name: Phosphoglycerate kinase Q1LSJ6
observations: Supplied 387-aa sequence is an exact full-length match to reviewed UniProt Q1LSJ6 (100% identity and coverage); annotated EC 2.7.2.3.
Catalyzes the reversible transfer of phosphate between 1,3-bisphosphoglycerate and ADP: 1,3-bisphosphoglycerate + ADP ⇌ 3-phosphoglycerate + ATP (Rhea: RHEA:14801).
Annotated in cytoplasm and glycolysis; sequence-level exact match supports identification, but no new experimental assay was performed.
